findings.finding: The previous ForwardedHeadersOptions cleared KnownNetworks and KnownProxies, allowing untrusted forwarded-header values to participate in proxy resolution.
findings.resolution: Render runtime no longer enables trust-all X-Forwarded-* processing. HTTPS is established from the Render runtime boundary, and login rate-limit identity uses a validated single CF-Connecting-IP only when RENDER=true, otherwise the socket remote address. Non-Render deployments retain bounded default forwarded-header trust with ForwardLimit=1.

directed_contracts: PagosOnline requires authorization and has no anonymous action
CargasMasivas requires authorization and caps upload size
Tienda public surface remains anonymous but rate-limited
Inbound webhook anonymous access is limited to the ingress action
Render accepts only a syntactically valid single CF-Connecting-IP for the rate-limit key
Malformed Render client-IP header falls back to socket address
Non-Render runtime ignores CF-Connecting-IP for the rate-limit key
notes: This review artifact is evidence-only. It does not change the functional candidate and may be treated as exact functional equivalence to 6ce3ec581adb4c2c3ccf21e6a6d32ccebc86e080 for N8.11.D.
